cli_help.stdout:
usage: agent-ee [-h]
                {doctor,review,inspect,verify,resume,adjudicate,close-correction}
                ...

CLI lifecycle. Interrupted runs preserve records; resumes always make fresh
runs.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,review,inspect,verify,resume,adjudicate,close-correction}
    doctor              inspect installed prerequisites; real runs establish
                        integration
    review              capture and review a fresh candidate
    resume              preserve old run; recapture/rerun all evidence into
                        new run

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: agent-ee doctor [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: agent-ee review [-h] --out OUT [--max-seconds MAX_SECONDS]
                       [--checks-only]
                       scope

positional arguments:
  scope

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT
  --max-seconds MAX_SECONDS
  --checks-only

usage: agent-ee inspect [-h] run

positional arguments:
  run

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: agent-ee verify [-h] [--snapshot-only] run

positional arguments:
  run

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --snapshot-only

usage: agent-ee resume [-h] --out OUT [--max-seconds MAX_SECONDS] run

positional arguments:
  run

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT
  --max-seconds MAX_SECONDS

usage: agent-ee adjudicate [-h] run decisions

positional arguments:
  run
  decisions

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: agent-ee close-correction [-h] --finding FINDING --checks CHECKS
                                 --reason REASON
                                 previous current

positional arguments:
  previous
  current

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --finding FINDING
  --checks CHECKS
  --reason REASON

usage: demo.py [-h] --out OUT [--seconds-per-run SECONDS_PER_RUN]

Run the real RC control, defect and disposable saved-design repair
demonstration.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT
  --seconds-per-run SECONDS_PER_RUN

usage: freshness_demo.py [-h] --disposable-root DISPOSABLE_ROOT --from-value
                         FROM_VALUE --to-value TO_VALUE --out OUT
                         run

Temporarily mutate only an explicit disposable design; demonstrate stale
refusal.

positional arguments:
  run

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --disposable-root DISPOSABLE_ROOT
  --from-value FROM_VALUE
  --to-value TO_VALUE
  --out OUT

usage: evidence_archive.py [-h] {pack,restore} ...

Pack complete recorded directories; restore without overwriting changed files.

positional arguments:
  {pack,restore}

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit

limits: Link paths checked against current checkout; command/help flags exercised without model calls. Workflow templates with operator-supplied paths/decisions require their stated prerequisites.
